panels.title: Peer calls during a search
How long an answered peer call took, by what it asked for
panels.description: The peer call budget bounds it.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, asked_for) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0)))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, asked_for) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0)))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, asked_for) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0)))

panels.title: Peer calls waiting for a slot
panels.description: Above zero means YACYDHTSEARCH_PEER_CALLS_IN_FLIGHT holds peer calls back.

panels.title: Peer calls that asked to search documents, by outcome
panels.description: Unreadable means an answer arrived that did not parse.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="search documents", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="search documents", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

panels.title: Peer calls that asked for URL metadata, by outcome

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="url metadata", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="url metadata", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_replica_asks_duration_seconds_bucket{ended_by="coverage", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_replica_asks_duration_seconds_bucket{ended_by="coverage", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0)))
